verdict.rationale: Mercury Books explicitly supports inviting bookkeepers/accountants directly into the account with role-tailored permissions and no seat caps, letting them view transactions, categorizations, and comment/tag on entries. This directly matches the founder story of role-scoped external collaborator access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the granularity of role permissions and no detail on whether accountants can 'adjust' books versus just comment/view.
